ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 70:30 ratio of high-intensity (white/light grey) to low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large high-intensity contiguous regions occupy the central-lateral portions of both lobes. A low-intensity central anchor-shaped region extends from the peduncle toward the median notch. Small-scale low-intensity mottling is distributed across the high-intensity regions, with a higher density near the trailing edges.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with a narrow vertex; estimated pixel-depth approximately 15% of the total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous, high-frequency serration along the entire trailing edge. Topography consists of irregular, low-amplitude peaks and valleys (3-10 pixels in depth relative to the edge) providing a jagged silhouette against the background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave sweep along the trailing edge from the notch to the tips; the distal tips exhibit a sharp upward and outward projection.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized clusters of low-intensity pixels (mottling) appearing as irregular circular spots across the high-intensity zones of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A series of roughly parallel, low-intensity vertical lines (rake marks) are visible on the high-intensity surface of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: The distal tips of both lobes show irregular, jagged material loss (chipping) suggesting prior mechanical trauma or environmental wear.
